title: Rosemary chicken and cannellini
summary: Rosemary chicken and cannellini is a italian dinner built around skinless chicken thigh fillets and canned cannellini beans, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Rosemary chicken and cannellini. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add skinless chicken thigh fillets and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and canned cannellini beans.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until fresh rosemary is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Rosemary chicken and cannellini before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Rosemary chicken and cannellini.
